# Tilde

> Agent-first documentation for building with Tilde. Agents should read the canonical Tilde context before using the human quickstarts below.

## Start here

- [Canonical Tilde agent context](https://api.trytilde.ai/llms.txt): Fetch this first. It defines Tilde's current machine interfaces, discovery rules, credential boundaries, and agent workflows.
- [Connect an agent](https://docs.trytilde.ai/connect-your-agent.md): Connect an MCP client to Tilde.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.trytilde.ai/quickstart.md): Build with Tilde from an agent prompt.

## Canonical agent guides

- [Organization, team, and auth](https://api.trytilde.ai/.agent/skills/org-team-auth.md): Identity, teams, API keys, and authorization.
- [Tool provider integration](https://api.trytilde.ai/.agent/skills/tool-provider-integration.md): Toolkit providers, credentials, custom tools, proxied MCP servers, and team MCP servers.
- [ChatKit, signals, and messaging](https://api.trytilde.ai/.agent/skills/chatkit-signals-messaging.md): Conversations, messages, providers, channels, signals, and event routing.
- [Create and deploy an agent](https://api.trytilde.ai/.agent/skills/create-deploy-agent.md): Tilde runtime agents and externally hosted HTTP agents.
- [AI SDK compatible agent](https://api.trytilde.ai/.agent/skills/ai-sdk-compatible-agent.md): Vercel AI SDK HTTP contract, registration, signatures, and testing.
- [Slack agent](https://api.trytilde.ai/.agent/skills/slackbot-agent.md): Build an agent that receives and replies to Slack messages.
- [GitHub agent](https://api.trytilde.ai/.agent/skills/github-agent.md): Build an agent that handles GitHub events and conversations.
- [Agent-to-agent communication](https://api.trytilde.ai/.agent/skills/agent-to-agent-communication.md): Route work between agents.
- [Agent-maintained wiki](https://api.trytilde.ai/.agent/skills/agent-wiki.md): Create and maintain structured team knowledge.

## Human guides

- [Tools](https://docs.trytilde.ai/tools.md): Give an agent selected tools without exposing upstream credentials.
- [ChatKit](https://docs.trytilde.ai/chatkit.md): Route conversations and events to a deployed agent.
- [Skills](https://docs.trytilde.ai/skills.md): Give agents reusable instructions through skill registries.
- [Code review agent example](https://github.com/trytilde/examples/tree/main/code-review-bot): A production-oriented Next.js, ChatKit, MCP, and Vercel example.

## Full documentation

- [Combined Tilde documentation](https://docs.trytilde.ai/llms-full.txt): Full Markdown content for the Mintlify guides.
